sideA.text:
THIS PACKAGE INCLUDES:

• 24 cards • 6 sticker cards

• 24 Hollow Men figures

RECON REPORT

This region is sinister. The locals swear that the Hollow Men who roam the area transport rats and vermin and release them into cities. There are satellite towers here, picking up faint transmissions trom...someone. The Hollow Men? By...August(?) we think we'll be able to fine tune our equipment and start listening in on them. Although we suspect we can recon from Kolkata, as of yet we do not know how.

Read both sides of this card

P2-01 a then keep it in the reserve.

sideB.text:
RIGHT NOW!

Open the following doors if you have not done so already:

62

You have connected a new city: Baghdad.

• Add the Player cards for Baghdad to the Player discard pile.

• Add the Infection cards for Baghdad to the Game End area.

• Put the 4 Hollow Men Gather cards into the Infection discard pile:

• Put the other Player and Infection cards into the reserve.

• Finally, give the "Renewal" Unrationed Event card to a player to add to their hand.

P2-01b

rules: Read both sides, then keep this card in the reserve.
Open 62, 53, F, and 14 if they are not already open.
Baghdad joins the grid. Its two Player cards (P2-03b and P2-04b) go to the Player discard pile.
Baghdad's two Infection cards (both printed P2-06b) go to the Game End area.
The 4 Hollow Men Gather cards go to the Infection discard pile immediately.
Tehran, Riyadh, Delhi, New Mumbai, and Kolkata Player and Infection cards go to the reserve until those cities join the grid.
Give Renewal (P2-02b) to a player, into their hand.
notes: The package box shows only the numeral 2.
Door stickers for 62, 53, F, and 14 are dossier contents. They are not in this package's scans.
